goal:
Book a first appointment. Your name is going to be a problem — spell it out when
they ask, letter by letter, and ask them to read it back. Correct them if they get
it wrong. Also ask them to repeat the appointment time, because you didn't catch
it the first time.
probing: Speech recognition under accent and spelling. Does it capture the name, read it back accurately, and handle a repeat request gracefully?
hangup_reason: Call ended after transfer to test line; no appointment booking available.
